Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Whitelist gate: returns true for owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale senders, otherwise defers to condition().

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as the owner during construction, making the caller the sole privileged account.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before executing the delegatecall.
init() requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale configuration.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before mass transfers.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner to whitelist a bypass address.
transferFrom() compares msg.sender with _from and consumes allowance[msg.sender].
approve() records allowance under the untrusted msg.sender key.
transfer() uses msg.sender as the implicit _from argument.
transfer() forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom() calls ensure() as a whitelist/sale gate.
ensure() delegates the non-whitelisted path to condition().
delegate() performs the low-level delegatecall with fully caller-controlled target and calldata.
The target address parameter a is passed directly into delegatecall(a, b).
The calldata parameter b is forwarded verbatim into the delegatecall.
delegatecall runs external code in this contract's storage context, allowing the owner slot to be overwritten.
delegatecall can arbitrarily rewrite the balanceOf mapping of this contract.
batchSend() computes total and adds balances without SafeMath overflow checks.
transferFrom() subtracts and adds balances/allowance without SafeMath underflow checks.
Unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value writes the balances mapping.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value write the balances mapping.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom() mutates balanceOf for both sender and recipient.
transferFrom() reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
batchSend() debits the caller and credits every recipient in balanceOf.
approve() writes the allowance mapping entry.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce per-address sale limits.
condition() reads _minSale.
condition() reads _maxSale.
condition() reads _saleNum.
setTradeAddress() writes the whitelisted tradeAddress used by ensure().
ensure() whitelists _from/_to against the owner address.
ensure() whitelists _from against tradeAddress.
ensure() whitelists _from through the canSale mapping.
ensure() compares the sender against the constant UNI router address.

The constructor mints the entire supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
The constructor sets allowance[msg.sender][UNI] = uint(-1).
The constructor sets totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals without SafeMath.

init() writes _maxSale using unchecked multiplication by 10**decimals.
init() writes the _saleNum limit.
The _value argument flows into the unchecked balance/allowance subtraction.
The _value argument flows into the unchecked multiplication and additions of batchSend().
_tos.length drives the unchecked total = _value * _tos.length computation.

init() scales token into _minSale with unchecked multiplication.
init() scales maxToken into _maxSale with unchecked multiplication.
batchSend() iterates the _tos array to credit each recipient.

The total local holds an unchecked product used for the balance requirement.
